name: Mamiya Haruichi
source:
Work: IT Entrepreneur
Hobby: Archery

Haruichi is an intelligent and shrewd businessman. He's polite and stern, but easily approachable which makes him very well-liked by his employees, particularly with the females (this also goes for your female colleagues at your company). You describe him as "perfect" and seem to not find any flaws in his character.
